content.text:
Perfect! All 41 tests pass. I've added two new functions to `src/invoices.js`:

1. **`addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })`** — Adds a new line or increases qty if that SKU already exists. Validates qty (QTY_INVALID) and SKU (UNKNOWN_SKU). Refuses non-draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT).

2. **`removeLine(invoice, sku)`** — Removes a line by SKU. Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice, NO_LINES if it would remove the last line, and refuses non-draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT).

Added 2 new error codes to `src/errors.js`: NOT_DRAFT, LINE_NOT_FOUND

Added 10 comprehensive tests covering:
- Adding new lines and increasing existing line quantities
- All error cases (not draft, invalid qty, unknown SKU, line not found, last line removal)
- No mutation of input invoices
